node.title: Re^7: How to install Perl modules locally on Unix?
node.author: choroba
node.doctext:
Maybe your shell isn't bash? IIRC, the default is dash on modern Ubuntus for /bin/sh, some people use ksh or zsh, and my boss at $job[0] used tcsh.
